title: Choose a new name: Stacks is unavailable on the App Store
acceptance: A name chosen and confirmed available in App Store Connect, not merely absent from App Store search
The rename lands before TestFlight, while the CloudKit container still holds only the owner's data
Bundle identifiers, app group, CloudKit container, product name, scheme, directory names and the repo are all updated together
notes: TIMING IS THE WHOLE POINT. Renaming changes the CloudKit container from iCloud.com.calvinbrown.Stacks, and container identity is what synced data hangs off — an existing container's records do not follow a rename. Today that costs nothing: the only data is the owner's, and T-0004 has not even confirmed sync works yet. After TestFlight it means abandoning every beta tester's library or writing a migration. Do it now or accept the name forever. Blast radius: project.yml, both .entitlements, Stacks/Services/AppGroup.swift, Tools/seed-simulator.sh, three bundle ids (app, ShareExtension, UITests), the app group, the CloudKit container, and the directories Stacks/, StacksShareExtension/, StacksUITests/, plus the repo name and README. Note SwiftReadability is already name-neutral and needs nothing. CONSTITUTION NOTE: X7 forbids agents changing signing or identity, so the implementation task must carry an explicit written exception from the overseer, the way T-0026 was granted permission to touch verify.sh.
